subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Five nights in 4-star hotels across Kunming, Dali and Lijiang. Visit Santorini (Dali Ideal City), Dali Old Town, Xizhou Ancient Town, Lijiang Ancient City, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain by cable car and Blue Moon Valley. Flights are via Guangzhou with China Southern Airlines.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 9–14 2026 to Mar 21–26 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Guangzhou – Kunming
items: Fly Manila to Guangzhou (CZ3092 12:00/14:40), then Guangzhou to Kunming (CZ3499 17:00/19:30).
Meet the guide at Kunming airport and check in to hotel. Meals: X/X/X.

itinerary.title: Kunming – Dali
items: Hotel breakfast and check out; drive to Dali.
After lunch, visit Santorini (Dali Ideal City) with afternoon tea (uphill electric vehicles included).
Visit Dali Old Town.
After dinner, hotel check-in. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Dali – Lijiang
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Xizhou Ancient Town, a Bai ethnic minority town.
Drive to Lijiang.
Visit the Medicinal Herbs Exhibition Center (medicine store).
Visit Lijiang Ancient City.
Optional tour 1: Dali Xizhou Music Caravan with singer performance, 1 drink, photo session (3 free digital photos), drone video (about 30 seconds) and Bai “Golden Flower” dance, USD 45 per person.
Optional tour 2: Lijiang Eternal Love Show, USD 60 per person. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Lijiang
items: Hotel breakfast.
Visit a latex or silk store.
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: take the Spruce Meadow cable car and watch the large-scale live performance “Impression Lijiang”.
Visit Blue Moon Valley (electric cart not included, USD 9 per person).
Optional upgrade: Lijiang Imperial Banquet instead of the group dinner, USD 25 per person (regular seat) or USD 40 (VIP seat). Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Lijiang – Kunming
items: Hotel breakfast and check out; drive back to Kunming.
Visit Chuxiong Yi Ancient Town.
Visit a jewelry shop.
Visit Kunming Old Street, Nanping Street and Jinma-Biji Archways. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Kunming – Guangzhou – Manila
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Park 1903.
Transfer to the airport; fly Kunming to Guangzhou (CZ3448 16:05/18:15; on Nov 9 CZ3408 17:15/19:20), then Guangzhou to Manila (CZ5051 23:45/02:20+1). Meals: B/X/X.

Yunnan has a large temperature difference between day and night and strong ultraviolet rays. Bring sun protection, a hat, sunglasses, a wind-proof jacket and a warm coat for high-altitude areas, and wear comfortable non-slip shoes.
At high altitude, slow down, drink plenty of warm water, rest well and avoid alcohol and strenuous exercise; inform the guide immediately if you feel severe dizziness or chest tightness.

Carry personal medications in their original packaging. Do not pick or eat wild mushrooms or fruits. Do not trust roadside vendors offering low prices; respect local ethnic minority customs and follow scenic area regulations.

placeDesc.Santorini (Dali Ideal City): A Greek-island-style white-and-blue resort complex overlooking Erhai Lake near Dali, with afternoon tea; uphill electric vehicles included.
placeDesc.Dali Old Town: A walled old town beside Erhai Lake with traditional Bai-style streets and shops.
placeDesc.Xizhou Ancient Town: A well-preserved Bai ethnic minority town near Dali, known for its traditional courtyard houses.
placeDesc.Lijiang Ancient City: A UNESCO-listed old town in Lijiang with cobbled lanes, canals and Naxi-style architecture.
placeDesc.Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: A snow-capped mountain range near Lijiang, reached by the Spruce Meadow cable car.
placeDesc.Impression Lijiang: A large-scale live outdoor performance staged against Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Blue Moon Valley: A highland lake valley at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain; electric cart not included, USD 9 per person.
placeDesc.Chuxiong Yi Ancient Town: A Yi ethnic town in Chuxiong prefecture, a rest and sightseeing stop on the drive back to Kunming.
placeDesc.Kunming Old Street: A traditional-style street in Kunming with shops and local snacks.
placeDesc.Nanping Street: A downtown Kunming shopping and street-food street, visited on the way back.
placeDesc.Jinma-Biji Archways: Two traditional archways in central Kunming, a well-known city landmark.
placeDesc.Park 1903: A Kunming heritage-themed park and shopping area visited on the last morning.
